messages: Create a marketing plan for a new smartphone launch.

title='Marketing Plan for New Smartphone Launch' steps=['Conduct market research to understand the target audience and competitive landscape.', 'Define the unique selling proposition (USP) of the smartphone.', 'Develop a campaign slogan and branding elements (logo, colors, etc.).', 'Design marketing materials, including advertisements, social media content, and webpages.', 'Plan a launch event to create a buzz around the product release.', 'Engage with influencers and tech reviewers to create anticipation and generate early reviews.', 'Plan a multi-channel marketing strategy, including digital, social media, and traditional media outlets.', 'Develop a promotions strategy with offers, bundles, or discounts to attract customers.', 'Create and implement a public relations strategy to manage media engagements and press releases.', 'Monitor and analyze campaign performance, making adjustments as needed based on data and feedback.'] timeline={'Market Research': 'Month 1', 'USP & Branding Development': 'Month 2', 'Pre-Launch Marketing (Teasers, Promotions, Influencer Collaborations)': 'Month 3', 'Launch Event': 'Start of Month 4', 'Ongoing Advertising & Promotions': 'Months 4-6', 'Performance Review & Tweaks': 'End of Month 6'}
